item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta (83)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.1.0-beta

Build 83

  • Sort and Show stay on the library. The current choice is visible without opening a menu.
  • Find duplicates opens the extra copies in the library. Select all, or use the arrow keys, then archive or trash.
  • The archive folder defaults to Pictures/TrailsRG/Archive and is created when that path is missing.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes.
